[{"step":1,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_binary_message.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":14,"var":"data/size","code":"memcpy(msg.data, data, size);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are copied into the message buffer that will be parsed by the server."},{"step":2,"file":"src/server/ua_server_binary.c","function":"processSecureChannelMessage","line":0,"var":"message","code":"processSecureChannelMessage(..., UA_MESSAGETYPE_MSG, ..., message)","note":"The fuzz target routes the raw bytes into MSG processing for binary request decoding."},{"step":3,"file":"src/server/ua_server_binary.c","function":"processMSG","line":392,"var":"requestTypeId","code":"UA_NodeId_decodeBinary(msg, &offset, &requestTypeId);","note":"The first decoded NodeId selects the request type and advances the parse offset."},{"step":4,"file":"src/server/ua_server_binary.c","function":"processMSG","line":458,"var":"requestHeader->authenticationToken","code":"UA_NodeId_deleteMembers(&requestHeader->authenticationToken);","note":"In fuzzing mode the request header token is explicitly deleted before being overwritten, so its identifierType controls whether a string/bytestring member is freed."},{"step":5,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"NodeId_deleteMembers","line":237,"var":"p->identifierType","code":"switch(p->identifierType) { case UA_NODEIDTYPE_STRING: case UA_NODEIDTYPE_BYTESTRING: String_deleteMembers(...); }","note":"If the token NodeId was decoded as a string or bytestring, the delete helper frees the embedded string buffer based on the decoded type tag."},{"step":6,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"String_deleteMembers","line":109,"var":"s->data","code":"UA_free((void*)((uintptr_t)s->data & ~(uintptr_t)UA_EMPTY_ARRAY_SENTINEL));","note":"The sink releases the pointer stored in the NodeId union; malformed or uninitialized union contents can propagate here and trigger MSAN use-of-uninitialized-value."}]
JSON
